label: Street a bike may use
method: I add up the length of every street segment inside the boundary where a bike may ride.
recipe: import csv;print(round(sum(float(r['length_m']) for r in csv.DictReader(open('segments.csv')) if True)/1000,3))

sources.name: OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.request: network.osm.gz and boundary.geojson in the snapshot folder

label: Street that is safe for a child to ride alone (AAA)
method: I score each edge for stress and keep the segments where every edge is AAA.
recipe: import csv;print(round(sum(float(r['length_m']) for r in csv.DictReader(open('segments.csv')) if r['aaa'] == '1')/1000,3))

label: Street with no width estimate
method: I try each width source in rank order. I count the segments where none gave a width.
recipe: import csv;print(round(sum(float(r['length_m']) for r in csv.DictReader(open('segments.csv')) if r['width_source'] == 'none')/1000,3))
